scraped.title: Prior Learning Policy Development
scraped.subtitle: Policy on Recognition of Prior Learning Policy Development (Egypt)
scraped.description: ICON-INSTITUT successfully implements the project “Policy on Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) Policy Development” in Egypt under a GIZ programme, financed by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). The project supports Egypt’s Technical…
body: ICON-INSTITUT successfully implements the project “Policy on Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) Policy Development” in Egypt under a GIZ programme, financed by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). The project supports Egypt’s Technical Education Reform 2.0 by developing a comprehensive national RPL policy framework that enables the formal recognition of skills acquired outside the traditional education system and aligns them with national and international TVET standards.

ICON-INSTITUT leads the design of the RPL framework based on international best practices, develops and pilots implementation models, and finalizes a nationally coordinated system with clear institutional roles and procedures. Through its work, ICON-INSTITUT is establishing a transparent and inclusive pathway for skills recognition, strengthening labour market relevance, and contributing to a more flexible and modern TVET system in Egypt.
